exceptions.description: Disputed installment 4/6 amount (R$ 5,649.25): does not match our original purchase order PO-2026-8841 (expected R$ 4,820.00 per installment).
exceptions.customer_response: Aurora Seguros provided the official premium breakdown on 06/11/2026. The base policy installment is R$ 4,820.00 (matching your PO-2026-8841), and Endorsement #1 added R$ 829.25 per installment for expanded berth cargo coverage (+IOF), totaling R$ 5,649.25. Breakdown document is attached for your review.
exceptions.resolution: Insurer breakdown received on 06/11/2026 confirming R$ 5,649.25 is accurate due to Endorsement #1 coverage addition.

exceptions.description: Customer uploaded receipt for remaining balance R$ 21,870.55 (2nd partial payment on installment 6/10). Verify clearing with Aurora Seguros.

exception_messages.body: Installment 4/6 is billed at R$ 5,649.25, whereas our Purchase Order PO-2026-8841 specifies R$ 4,820.00. Please verify with Aurora Seguros.
